blocks.text: Dumaguete City, known for its rich traditions and vibrant academic community, welcomes a new cultural landmark with the opening of Museo P. Lhuillier. Featuring an exceptional collection of European paintings, sculptures, period furniture, and religious antiquities, the museum offers visitors a rare opportunity to discover remarkable works spanning different artistic periods and traditions, each reflecting the influences and stories of its time. The collection belongs to the Philippine Ambassador for Spain and Andorra H.E. Philippe J. Lhuillier and his wife, Mrs. Edna Diago-Lhuillier, whose shared appreciation for artistic expression and historical preservation inspired the museum’s creation.
